title: Import M-Pesa data
neverLeave: Your statements never leave your phone. Backups are encrypted with your key.
passwordNote: If importing a PDF, the password is whatever you type. It is NOT your ID, and it is NOT saved.

share.hint: On Android, install PesaSense, then select M-Pesa texts in your SMS app and tap Share, then PesaSense. The text stays on this phone. A share is one message or a short selection, not your full history. On iPhone, paste the messages or use the statement PDF.
share.title: Shared M-Pesa messages
share.stays: Read on this phone. Nothing from the share is uploaded.
share.empty: Nothing is waiting. Share M-Pesa texts from your SMS app into the installed app, or paste them below.
share.missed: That share did not stay on this phone, so it was dropped. Paste the messages instead.
share.large: That selection was too long to keep on this phone. Share fewer messages, or paste them.

sms.placeholder: Paste your raw M-Pesa transaction messages here...
sms.comingSoon: Reading a real statement is coming soon. Falling back to the demo profile...
sms.unreadable: We couldn't read that data. Try pasting the full SMS, or use the demo profile.

pdf.chooseFirst: Choose your M-Pesa statement PDF first.
pdf.enterPassword: Enter the password you use to open this PDF.
pdf.once: Used once to decrypt on your phone. Not your ID. Not saved.
pdf.comingSoon: Reading a real statement is coming soon. Falling back to the demo profile...
pdf.unreadable: We could not read that PDF. Check the password, or paste SMS messages instead.
pdf.badPassword: Could not open the PDF. Check the statement password and try again.
pdf.freshExport: Could not read this PDF. Try exporting a fresh M-Pesa statement.
pdf.noText: This PDF has no readable text. Try the SMS paste option instead.
pdf.noRows: We opened the PDF but could not read transaction rows. Try pasting the same period as M-Pesa SMS messages below, or export a statement with a text table (not a scan).
pdf.fewTransactions: We only found {count} transactions in that file. Export about six months from M-Pesa, or paste SMS messages instead.
pdf.noIncome: We could not see regular money coming in (salary or transfers). This PDF layout may not be supported yet — paste your M-Pesa SMS messages instead.
pdf.noSpending: We could not see enough spending or bill payments. Paste M-Pesa SMS messages for a fuller picture.
pdf.nearZero: The numbers do not look like a real six-month picture (income and surplus are near zero). Paste M-Pesa SMS messages instead of this PDF for now.
pdf.noRange: We could not build a surplus range from this PDF. Paste M-Pesa SMS messages — that path works today.
pdf.tooThin: The profile looks too thin to trust. Try SMS paste, or export a longer statement period.

sync.title: Private copy
sync.body: Encrypt this profile on this device and store it on Nostr. The key stays in this browser. A separate anonymous note can share only the surplus range.
sync.none: No encrypted profile is stored yet.
sync.loaded: Loaded a profile. Surplus floor is {amount}.
sync.shared: Shared an anonymous surplus range. No phone number or wallet address was included.
sync.shareFailed: Could not share the surplus range.
sync.unreadable: The saved profile could not be read.
